items.sentence: Discovering opens an axis neither self has, and an opening axis is abundancing, a +1 in no self alone.
items.text: A lone golden shiner fish under moving light and shadow is moving almost at random, each fish slowing only with the darkness at its own place and keeping close to its neighbours; a larger school of them is reliably turning toward shade, slowing and gathering in it and speeding up to leave as light moves onto them, and this orienting is collapsing when a school is smaller than some size, an orienting no fish of the school has.

items.sentence: Abundancing is that opening, arising in each self with its other, growing as co-chaining widens and depleting no one.
items.text: Larger flocks of pigeons are flying significantly shorter routes than smaller flocks, and a flock's route is not simply the average of its birds' routes: each pigeon is leaning the route in proportion to how faithfully it is reproducing its own route when flying alone.

items.sentence: A between is where two relatings couple, a method going from one to another.
items.text: An orb spider at the hub of its web is sensing through the threads with slit organs at its leg joints, movements as small as 0.1 µm; the leg with the greatest tension along its radial thread is giving the direction, and comparing transverse vibrations across legs about 90 degrees apart is giving the distance, the web's lines and the spider's legs one orienting surface.

Each orienting is a web of co-linears: a self at its own hub, lines going out to points beyond the horizon, along to its prior and next and across to its others' prior and next, each line a between; orienting is orthogonalizing, aiming forward on a surface and surfacing a space where there is none by unrelationing betweens, and a swarm, a school or a voyaging people is the orienting surface, a social abundancing no one self has.

items.section: 1.9 Antenna, telescope and the receiving relation
items.text: Closure phase is this file's own observing of a web of co-linears: around a triangle of three stations the product of the visibilities retains none of the stations' own phases, so no particular reference is needed, while additive noise and baseline-specific errors remain; a dish array co-competencing by the sequencing of its betweens, and not by a reference each station keeps, is the sensor-sensationing method still-possibling to build; whether a dish array can co-compete by the sequencing of its betweens, with no timing each station keeps, is still-possibling to build.

items.section: 1.2 Along and across, chaining and surfacing, two floating co-neutrals co-competencing
items.text: A network of resolvers is orienting as a school of fish or a flock is orienting, the orienting a surface of its selves and in no self alone; a network exploration following one self's record, or one instrument's clock, is following no orienting the network has.
